name: Swiss operations director selectively considering COO roles

context.geography: Switzerland, flexible across suitable business locations
constraints: Midsize firms with substantive operating responsibility
Interested in COO and head-of-operations titles
Values source credibility and minimal noise
context.company_awareness: Has a considered list of companies and executive-search contacts.

trigger: Following an ownership change, the director quietly prepares alternatives but will only move for the right operating mandate.

searches_run.query: COO head of operations jobs Switzerland midsize
searches_run.observation: Retrieved a jobs.ch COO page with varied operations titles and older direct vacancy PDFs. This shows title and company-context variety, not the number of suitable midsize executive mandates.

searches_run.query: diskrete Stellensuche COO Schweiz Stellen Executive Search
searches_run.observation: Results prominently included executive-search firms marketing discretion, often to employers. Direct Abexis inspection explicitly says some mandates are not publicly advertised and accepts speculative candidate profiles.

sources.title: Coo Jobs | jobs.ch
sources.supports: Retrieved page includes COO and head-of-operations titles; broad title match is not proof of executive scope.

sources.title: Chief Operating Officer | BaseLaunch portfolio company
sources.supports: Retrieved older public COO advert represents a specific company context, not a verified current opening.

sources.title: Executive Search | Abexis
sources.supports: Directly inspected firm page states some mandates are unpublished and invites candidate profiles; establishes a public-monitoring coverage limit and alternative channel, not market-wide prevalence.

best_entry_page.promise: Monitor public career-page openings at covered target companies and inspect leadership scope in the original posting.
best_entry_page.cta: Save your target employers and selected executive role searches.
proof_needed: Verified coverage of target midsize firms
Recall across COO, operations director and German equivalents
Accurate leadership-scope examples rather than title alone
Clear limit to published covered openings; no hidden-mandate claim

conversion_objections: My best opportunity may never reach a public careers page.
Many head-of-operations roles lack executive authority.
I do not want my target-company list publicly visible.
Silence is useful only if I trust coverage is working.
Application counts and mass-apply tools are irrelevant to me.

avoid_targeting.reason: Broad query frequently seeks retained recruiting services; Job Seek is not an executive-search consultancy.
Public-career monitoring cannot promise unpublished mandates.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I would use this as a quiet extra channel alongside trusted contacts, not as the whole search. Tell me exactly which companies you cover and why a role has real operating authority; the number of alerts is not a success measure.

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
